findings.trigger: If a local server responds, the original integration tests select schema.DB_NAME and invoke destructive loader reloads against the ordinary solmargintrader store.
findings.fix: Each fixture now generates a private solmargintrader_test_<uuid> namespace; native loaders reuse the owned client and scoped database name; setup/error/cleanup tests verify only that namespace is selected and dropped.

findings.trigger: A valid empty or partial store returns null for breakout; card._id dereference aborts the remaining query file.
findings.fix: Print an explicit missing-card message and continue; present-record output remains covered.

findings.trigger: A store without SOL daily readouts returns null; sol.decision_bar dereference aborts later sections.
findings.fix: Print an explicit missing-readout message and continue; present-record output remains covered.

findings.trigger: A normal checkout without a run manifest loads no backtest_runs; run._id dereference aborts the query file.
findings.fix: Print an explicit missing-run message and continue; present-record output remains covered.

findings.trigger: The original health predicate assumes NaN differs from itself, but MongoDB compares NaN equal to NaN; both infinities also compare equal to themselves. It reports no matching rows for every non-finite specimen.
findings.fix: Explicit numeric membership in [NaN, Infinity, -Infinity], retaining the double type guard; inert predicate regression covers finite/non-numeric controls.

findings.trigger: Invoking the loader with the explicit worktree virtualenv does not activate PATH. Bare python3 resolved to Homebrew Python3.15, outside the worktree venv used to run the loader.
findings.fix: Python suite commands use sys.executable; mocked suite receipts verify both observed subprocess commands stay in the current environment.

findings.trigger: The setup instructions prescribe bare pip install with no isolated-environment recipe.
findings.fix: Document uv venv plus explicit .venv interpreter installation/invocation; no installation was performed by this audit.

findings.trigger: Script invocations with missing pymongo or a missing indirect dependency exit with raw tracebacks. Unavailable server errors also expose raw driver text.
findings.fix: Shared CLI-only handler exits3 for known missing packages and server selection timeouts, names exact isolated repair commands, and emits fixed redacted server messages. Library imports and main() exception semantics remain unchanged.

findings.trigger: The CLI help omits a runnable example.
findings.fix: Both argparse epilogs contain an explicit .venv invocation; subprocess tests cover help0, unknown-argument usage2 and driver-free describe.

findings.trigger: Operational prose/headings claim25/29 registered strategies and20 indicator documents, while the current card/registry inspection returns34/34 and the actual selected dry-run returns22 indicators.
findings.fix: Remove stale hand-maintained operational counts and point the README to the actual dry-run inventory. No frozen economic research result was edited.
